mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.category_id, c.name AS category_name, s.icon, s.description, s.status, s.created_time FROM user_scene_favorite f INNER JOIN ai_scene s ON f.scene_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ai_scene_category c ON s.category_id = c.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.created_time DESC
SELECT * FROM user_scene_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scene_id = #{sceneId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_scene_favorite (user_id, scene_id, created_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sceneId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_scene_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scene_id = #{sceneId}
